settings.about_title: We Are a Multidisciplinary Consulting & Digital Solutions Company
settings.about_paragraph_1: JEFAD Transnational is a multidisciplinary consulting and digital solutions company focused on helping businesses and professionals achieve operational excellence, digital transformation, financial education and sustainable growth.
settings.about_paragraph_2: Our expertise spans engineering consulting, water treatment, food safety and hygiene, virtual assistant services, digital marketing, AI-powered business solutions, hospitality consulting, and professional development.
settings.about_paragraph_3: In addition to our consulting services, JEFAD develops educational content and strategic partnerships with reputable organisations to connect individuals and businesses with valuable tools, technologies, and financial solutions.
settings.about_quote: Ethical marketing, educational content and long-term client relationships guide everything we do.
